evidence:
Re-checked on 20 September 2026 on build v26.36.8-d146c39, after the report for it was marked complete.

Work order S9160-17671 was opened; it carries a brake shoe kit and two transmission lines. The same two searches were then run twice - once from a Customers page and once from that work order page:
  'Brake Shoe'          identical six rows, every one scoring 1.00, in both places
  'Transmission filter' identical six rows, every one scoring 1.00, in both places

The specification says a part already on the work order you are looking at should be pushed down. That cannot happen here, because the rows are already at the highest score the search can give, so subtracting from them changes nothing.

What needs to be done: this is the same underlying cause as the separate report about the highest score being reached too easily. It cannot be judged as fixed until that is addressed.
